(Currently Amended) 1. A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, further comprising means for adding and removing an investment from the investment portfolio.

(Currently Amended) 4. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in adding an investment to and removing an investment from the investment portfolio.

(Currently Amended) 5. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in removing an investment from the investment portfolio, further comprising means for adding an investment to the investment portfolio.

(Currently Amended) 17. The computer program claimed in claim 15 or claim 16, said computer program for performing the step of allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio, further comprising means for adding and removing an investment from the investment portfolio.
